lateFieldDeleteResponse.classification: Existing loadFieldUpdates race; actual current owner-delete API makes this UI resurrection reachable. Subsequent fresh GET removes it; deletion remains committed in memory DB. Not a newly introduced PR regression.

limitationsNotes: Desktop/mobile viewport emulation does not test a physical device keyboard/GPS.
Actual Leaflet engine is required. CDN bootstrap failures are recorded separately.
window.open and geolocation are synthetic to avoid launching external routes or using physical location.
All API methods run against local memory actual reports handler; not deployed configuration tests.
Late cache behavior is observed separately and must be compared to unchanged baseline source.

harnessAdaptation.reason: Expired stored today must stay reference. Unconfirmed raw-today probes temporarily remove verified weekly alternatives; normal restoration and live merge assert eligible week_forecast fallback, while raw root/item provenance remains equal but expired.
